items.raw_excerpt: Line Barfod, the Copenhagen mayor for climate, environment and technology, has called for a 30km/h speed limit to be introduced in the vast majority of the city in a bid to make it safer and more bicycle-friendly.
items.summary_en: Copenhagen's climate and environment mayor is pushing for a 30 km/h speed limit in most of the city. She says it will make streets safer and more friendly for bicycles. The plan is part of her push for a greener, more livable capital.

items.raw_excerpt: Austria’s new rent rules put tighter limits on many index-linked increases in 2026. But whether your landlord can raise your rent, and by how much, still depends on your contract and the type of home you rent.

items.raw_excerpt: The nationwide hosepipe ban in place since late last month has been extended in 13 counties, with the ban lifting on 26 August for 13 other counties, Uisce Éireann has said.
items.summary_en: Ireland's water utility Uisce Éireann has extended a hosepipe ban in 13 counties due to ongoing water supply pressures. The ban, in place since late last month, will lift on 26 August for 13 other counties. The restriction limits domestic water use to essential purposes only.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드 수도 공기업 Uisce Éireann이 수도 공급 압박으로 인해 13개 카운티의 호스 사용 금지를 연장했다. 지난달 말부터 시행 중인 이번 금지는 8월 26일부터 나머지 13개 카운티에서 해제될 예정이다. 이 제한은 가정용수를 필수 용도로만 사용하도록 규정하고 있다.
items.title_en: Hosepipe ban extended in 13 Irish counties
items.title_ko: 아일랜드 13개 카운티 hosespipe 사용 금지 연장
items.title_original: Hosepipe ban extension for 13 counties

items.raw_excerpt: NUS, SUTD and SIT do not use automated AI detectors, while SMU says such tools are only one input when investigating possible misconduct.
items.summary_en: Several Singapore universities have stopped using automated AI detectors. They say the tools are not reliable enough to prove student misconduct. More universities are now questioning whether AI detection software works fairly.

items.raw_excerpt: The first year of operations for the PSP’s National Foreigners and Borders Unit (UNEF), which concluded on 21 August, has been marked by various airport difficulties, and the officers’ union describes it as a “very turbulent year.”
items.summary_en: Portugal's National Foreigners and Borders Unit completed its first year of operations on August 21. The officers' union described it as a very turbulent year marked by airport difficulties. The unit handles foreigner and border control at Portuguese airports.
